scientific_integrity: Analytical dominated-convergence and strong-connectivity proof; exact finite rational verification is supplementary and cannot establish infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed odd voter count and fixed size at least three, impartial culture only; constant is a convergent integral, not a closed elementary form; no convergence-rate bound or growing-size result; independent priority verification outstanding.
title: Exact fixed-size Smith-set asymptotics and the limiting rare-component geometry
